mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.sku_id AS skuId, c.quantity AS quantity, s.sku_name AS skuName, s.price AS price, p.id AS productId, p.spu_name AS productName, p.main_img AS mainImg, p.status AS productStatus FROM t_cart c JOIN t_product_sku s ON s.id = c.sku_id JOIN t_product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS id, c.sku_id AS skuId, c.quantity AS quantity, s.sku_name AS skuName, s.price AS price, p.id AS productId, p.spu_name AS productName, p.main_img AS mainImg, p.status AS productStatus FROM t_cart c JOIN t_product_sku s ON s.id = c.sku_id JOIN t_product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_cart (user_id, sku_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_cart WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
